title: About 360° Thrift Studio
intro: Good clothes. Bigger stories. We grade, count and pack pre-owned branded clothing and bags for resellers across the UK and worldwide.

sections.heading: Vintage · Premium · Wholesale
sections.body:
360° Thrift Studio supplies graded wholesale lots and bales to online resellers, vintage shops, market traders and importers.

Every lot is sorted by section, brand and style, with pieces, weight and grade stated up front.

sections.heading: Offices & warehouses
sections.body:
- United Kingdom — office & warehouse
- Pakistan — office & warehouse

sections.heading: Rewear. Resell. Repeat.
sections.body: Every garment we sell gets a second life. Thrift more, waste less.

sections.heading: Independent reseller
sections.body: We are an independent reseller of pre-owned goods. We are not affiliated with or endorsed by any brand shown on this site.

title: How to buy
intro: No checkout, no card needed. Build a quote basket and we reply with a quote and invoice.

sections.heading: 1. Browse
sections.body: Filter by section, brand, style, grade and lot size. Every lot shows pieces, weight and grade.

sections.heading: 2. Add to quote
sections.body: Add lots and quantities to your quote basket. Guide prices update as quantities change.

sections.heading: 3. Request your quote
sections.body: Tell us your company, delivery and payment preference. We reply within 1 working day, usually sooner. Stock is held for 48 hours while we prepare your quote.

sections.heading: 4. Pay & dispatch
sections.body: Accept the quote, pay by bank transfer or card payment link, and we dispatch within 24 hours of payment.

sections.heading: Guide prices
sections.body: All prices on the site are guide prices, excluding VAT and shipping. The final price is on your quote.

title: Grading guide
intro: Honest grades, stated on every lot. Here is what each grade means.

sections.heading: Cream
sections.body: Top pick of the grade. Clean, strong colour, no visible flaws. Ready to list.

sections.heading: Grade A
sections.body: Very good pre-owned condition. Light signs of wear at most. Ready to list after a quick check.

sections.heading: Grade B
sections.body: Good wearable condition with minor flaws such as light marks, fading or small repairs. Priced for volume.

sections.heading: Mixed
sections.body: A stated mix of grades. The lot page lists the split.

sections.heading: Verified era
sections.body: "Verified vintage" and "Verified Y2K" are only used when labels and construction confirm the production era. "Y2K style" means the look, not the era.

title: Shipping
intro: UK and worldwide dispatch from our warehouses.

sections.heading: Options
sections.body:
- Collect from the warehouse (by appointment)
- UK courier
- Pallet delivery
- International shipping — documents provided

sections.heading: Dispatch
sections.body: Orders are dispatched within 24 hours of payment. Shipping is quoted with your order.

title: Warehouse visit
intro: See the stock before you buy. Visits are by appointment.

sections.heading: Book a visit
sections.body: Contact us with your preferred date, the sections you are interested in and your company name. We will confirm a time and have the relevant lots ready.

sections.heading: Do I pay online?
sections.body: No. You send a quote request and we reply with a quote and invoice. Pay by bank transfer or card link.

sections.heading: Is there a minimum order?
sections.body: Minimum order is shown on each lot. Most lots start at 1.

sections.heading: Can I see trade prices?
sections.body: Some lots show trade prices after a quick account check. Open a trade account to see them.

sections.heading: Do you ship internationally?
sections.body: Yes. We ship worldwide and provide shipping documents.

sections.heading: Can you source luxury items?
sections.body: Yes — Dior, Gucci and Louis Vuitton on request. Tell us the brand, model and budget.
